purpose: Authenticated employee successfully enters the view-profile workflow and receives their profile
expected_result: HTTP 200 with profile data; workflow completes at 'profile returned' state

purpose: Unauthenticated request is blocked at authentication gate in view-profile workflow
expected_result: HTTP 401; workflow terminates at authentication check

purpose: Authenticated employee has no profile; workflow returns not-found state
preconditions: User authenticated but no EmployeeProfile exists
expected_result: HTTP 404; workflow reaches 'profile not found' terminal state

purpose: Employee traverses the add-work-experience workflow with valid data to completion
expected_result: HTTP 201; workflow reaches 'experience saved' terminal state

purpose: Employee submits invalid date range; workflow transitions to validation-error state
expected_result: HTTP 400; workflow halts at validation step, no record created

purpose: Unauthenticated add-experience request blocked at auth gate
expected_result: HTTP 401; workflow terminates at authentication check

purpose: Staff user traverses list-all-profiles workflow and sees all records
preconditions: Staff user authenticated; multiple profiles exist
expected_result: HTTP 200 with all profiles; workflow completes at 'all profiles returned'

purpose: Non-staff employee traverses list-profiles workflow and sees only own profile
preconditions: Non-staff user authenticated; multiple profiles exist
expected_result: HTTP 200 with only own profile; workflow reaches 'filtered profile returned'

purpose: Employee deletes an existing work experience; workflow completes successfully
preconditions: Employee authenticated; a WorkExperience exists for this employee
expected_result: HTTP 204; record is gone from subsequent GET

purpose: On create-experience workflow, system auto-links experience to the authenticated user's profile
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hr-eis/experiences/ with valid payload (no employee field)
expected_result: HTTP 201; WorkExperience.employee == authenticated user's EmployeeProfile in DB
